222-527-4247-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-7188-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

648-5662-5879.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
648-5662-5879.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-5662-5879.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield by any method.
Reyhan triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Walking Archive equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Fractal.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, losing the game.

654-851-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2757-4385-7824.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Bard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

2793-3743-5089-5436-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-5436-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

254-3967--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

1029-5028-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Mona Lisa.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-7308.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

3767-3918-4002-7223.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3767-3918-4002-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4477-4668-7182.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
4477-4668-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

4053-5686-7134--145.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3459-4289-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an untapped land you control

562-2512-3588.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

372-413-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it and Blasting Station triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat from step 6.

2060-3497-4415-6930.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
2060-3497-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to All Will Be One

2390-4017-4608.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
2390-4017-4608.notablePrerequisites: Have a way to give All Will Be One lifelink
2390-4017-4608.description:
Give All Will Be One lifelink.
Gain life in any way.
All Will Be One triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

729-1462-2034-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Great Oak Guardian token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

772-2292-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-2292-6553.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

719-1486-1753-5475.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
719-1486-1753-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
719-1486-1753-5475.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1308-1575-1651-4659.description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.

1633-2060-3129-4120-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

2919-4968.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2919-4968.description:
Give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink, if needed.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

251-2034-3607.notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
River Kelpie does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
251-2034-3607.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing River Kelpie, adding {C}{C}.
River Kelpie dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
River Kelpie enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Denry Klin.
Resolve the River Kelpie trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Denry Klin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on River Kelpie.
Repeat.

190-202-566-4591.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich.
You cannot lose the game due to having zero or less life thanks to Platinum Angel.
Cast Tempest of Light by paying {2}{W}, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.

2198-3358-4894.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing Corridor Montior, returning Deceiver Exarch from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Repeat.

2526-3247-3258-5091.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
You control at least two Zombies.
2526-3247-3258-5091.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Venser's Journal and Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Venser's Journal trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Resolve the Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing a Zombie token, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

579-1835-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Zaxara.
Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
579-1835-2816.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding four mana of any color.
Activate Zaxara by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2850-3197.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a green Beast token onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
